oracleRisk.summary: STAC is a tokenized fund share of the Securitize Tokenized AAA CLO Fund. Its price is the fund's net asset value: valuation is determined inside the fund's own administration and valuation process and is delivered to Chronicle by custodians, fund administrators and other service providers, which Chronicle verifies and publishes onchain as Proof of Asset. Chronicle's publication is a verification and transport layer, not an independent valuation authority, and the issuer release names BNY as custodian of the fund's underlying assets and sub-adviser through BNY Investments without identifying an independent NAV calculation authority. STAC has no borrower market, no collateral-liquidation engine and no secondary price feed whose staleness or failure could impair a lending book. The reviewed price authority is therefore privileged internal fund NAV plus a single Chronicle publication path.

branchApplicability.rationale: The only price-sensitive input is the fund share net asset value used for primary subscription and redemption at NAV. Securitize issues STAC natively on Ethereum and Solana against fund shares and publishes no borrower market, collateral-health oracle, forced-liquidation path or other branch whose pricing would need a separate oracle review. The Chronicle Proof of Asset feed observed by the reviewed reserve adapter (consumer 0x9D77E4cA90E25114AFb24dF908f5918f572D958B, native-fund-share NAV scope) publishes the same top-level NAV, so the review stays top-level and no branch is applicable.

At finalized Solana slot 452212788, mint u49MwZqu4bHRHRsciaBarHK7JZDYGxuaNnwyMBdEKYk retained freezeAuthority and permanentDelegate GSM7ZTDNByoGwayftzcSrDqWmMF9L3mU6KLVrca57j2M, plus a transfer hook. bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Securitize administers STAC as native issuer issuance on Ethereum and Solana. Current Ethereum owner/implementation reads and Solana Token-2022 mint/freeze authority reads support two native issuance surfaces; no holder-operated third-party bridge, conserved-supply transport, or bridge-admin route is identified.
